proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ x
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mem_integers_of_valuation_le_one K x h
    exact NumberField.RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe y
  · intro h v
    have : x = algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K ⟨x, h⟩ := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_le_one v _
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : K), (∀ v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K), IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v x ≤ 1) ↔ IsIntegral ℤ x
